pins.name: Andrews Creek Trailhead
pins.directions: From Highway 20 in Winthrop, turn onto County Road 1213 (West Chewuch Road) and follow it about 6 miles to where it joins Forest Road 51. Continue north on FR 51 to the end of the pavement and turn right into the Andrews Creek Trailhead at 3,050 ft. A Northwest Forest Pass or Interagency pass is needed to park, and a free self-issued Pasayten Wilderness permit is required.

pins.name: Amphitheater Mountain Summit
pins.directions: Hike Andrews Creek Trail #504 about 12 miles over Andrews Pass, then 3 miles down to the Spanish Camp guard station, and take the trail on the right just before the cabin 3 miles to Upper Cathedral Lake. From the lake follow the trail around the toe of the west ridge about half a mile to a boot path at about 7,200 ft; climb grass and scree into the basin at 8,000 ft, then walk the plateau to its highest point.
